topic_coverage.quoted_user_text: New install with mode missing or upgrade must include all required scripts, with no missing framework-critical files after installation.
installer.ps1, installer.sh, installer.py, template/scripts/, package files manifest, and install mode logic for missing/upgrade behavior.
Must preserve user files in upgrade mode and avoid destructive overwrite. Keep parity across PowerShell, shell, and Python installer paths.
Add fixtures/regression for fresh install missing mode and upgrade mode validating required script inventory; include parity checks and failure diagnostics.
Bug is done when reproducible installs in missing and upgrade modes produce complete required scripts set with tests guarding against regression.
